accepted_scope_rows.ScopeItemStatement: Allow the person to set direct application or proposal requirements per operation class and consequence.
Agents may prepare human decisions but never falsely originate or record a human act in the person's name.
Do not present agent outputs as professionally certified, sealed, approved or code-compliant.
Name and enforce the human acts reserved by the adopted operation policy, including against external agents, without treating the pending global list as settled.
Label proposal decisions as accept rather than approve because edit acceptance is distinct from engineering approval.
Use conservative defaults for consequential host operations.
